nodes.label: External Sources
nodes.summary: Potential job providers
nodes.notes: Evaluate candidate sources LinkedIn, Wuzzuf, Bayt and JSearch API. Record permission, country coverage, fields, rate limits, pagination, acquisition limits and retention. Use one authorized connector for MVP.

nodes.label: Ingestion
nodes.summary: Collection orchestration
nodes.notes: Use run UUID and per-page checkpoint after commit. Retry transient 429 and 5xx with Retry-After, jitter and cap. Schedule with cron or manual command.

nodes.label: Raw Storage
nodes.summary: Immutable provider payloads
nodes.notes: Write atomically via temp file, then register manifest. Save provider ID, publication value/version when present, ingest time and source identity.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.summary: Validation and deduplication
nodes.notes: Preserve original text, normalize country/title separately, adopt source ID, then exact independently verified identity. Treat weak cross-source matches as review candidates.

nodes.label: Structured Storage
nodes.summary: Canonical jobs and skills
nodes.notes: Use UUID job PK, source-level uniqueness, immutable description hash, active result selection, indexes for filters and backup/restore.

nodes.label: AI / NLP
nodes.summary: Versioned skill enrichment
nodes.notes: Keep offsets in original text using a match-to-original map. Disambiguate short aliases. Store unmatched as candidates; publish results atomically by version.

nodes.label: Analytics
nodes.summary: Metrics and coverage
nodes.notes: Filter once by [from,to), count distinct jobs per skill, report eligible and enriched counts. Trends compare equal windows and source composition.

nodes.label: Backend
nodes.summary: REST API and query services
nodes.notes: Describe endpoints via OpenAPI. Use stable cursor ordered by date and UUID, bounded page size, request ID and parameterized SQL.

nodes.label: Frontend
nodes.summary: Market intelligence dashboard
nodes.notes: Keep shared query state, abort outdated requests, display sample size and basis, test loading/empty/error and keyboard access.

nodes.label: Platform Operations
nodes.summary: Scheduling, CI, logs and recovery
nodes.notes: Unit tests on each PR, integration with disposable PostgreSQL, smoke and restore on clean machine. Record run IDs, durations and safe error classes.

nodes.label: Provider approval
nodes.summary: Compare access, terms, geographic coverage, quota and retention; approve one source
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Candidate notes for LinkedIn, Wuzzuf, Bayt, JSearch API and backup provider
Outputs: Approved source capability record or explicit no-go

nodes.label: Adapter registry
nodes.summary: Register one authorized implementation under a stable source slug
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Approved capability record and credential variable names
Outputs: Adapter registration and conformance fixture

nodes.label: Source health
nodes.summary: Check quota, failures, changed fields and coverage by country
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Run ledger, response codes and observed countries
Outputs: Source health note and escalation decision

nodes.label: Source selection
nodes.summary: Resolve the approved provider, country/role query and execution cap
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Capability record and requested window
Outputs: Validated run configuration

nodes.label: Source adapter
nodes.summary: Map common connector inputs to provider-specific request fields
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Run configuration and adapter registry
Outputs: Provider request plan without secrets in logs

nodes.label: API or actor execution
nodes.summary: Invoke the approved endpoint or actor with timeouts and a per-run budget
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Provider request and injected credential
Outputs: Provider response and remote run identifier

nodes.label: Pagination and collection
nodes.summary: Resume from the stored cursor; retry transient failures within the run budget
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Provider response page and durable page token
Outputs: Validated records and cursor candidate

nodes.label: Raw persistence
nodes.summary: Write completed page to the immutable archive before advancing its cursor
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Original provider bytes and run UUID
Outputs: Raw archive reference and checksum

nodes.label: Collection metadata
nodes.summary: Record page counts, source, query, timestamps and committed cursor
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Manifest, checksums and response metadata
Outputs: Run ledger and counters

nodes.label: Completion or failure
nodes.summary: Reconcile counters and classify successful, partial or failed run
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Ledger and safe error class
Outputs: Terminal status with replay or escalation decision

nodes.label: Envelope validation
nodes.summary: Check source and run identity, checksum format and ordinal uniqueness
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Provider payload and metadata
Outputs: Accepted versioned envelope or rejection

nodes.label: Immutable archive
nodes.summary: Atomically persist original payload in restricted storage
nodes.notes:
Inputs: RawEnvelope and provider bytes
Outputs: Archive path and SHA-256

nodes.label: Manifest and hash
nodes.summary: Commit run-to-object metadata and confirm integrity
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Archive reference, source ID and timestamp
Outputs: Manifest row and durable cursor boundary

nodes.label: Replay reader
nodes.summary: Verify hash, then stream archived records from selected run
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Run ID, archive location and checksum
Outputs: Ordered raw records for reprocessing

nodes.label: Raw record
nodes.summary: Load the immutable record, retaining its reference and version
nodes.notes:
Inputs: RawEnvelope v1 and archive bytes
Outputs: Raw payload plus provenance metadata

nodes.label: Validation
nodes.summary: Check required fields and types, and quarantine malformed input
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Raw record and source field map
Outputs: Accepted field map or safe rejection reason

nodes.label: Cleaning
nodes.summary: Trim and canonicalize display fields while retaining original description
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Validated values and locale rules
Outputs: Cleaned fields with quality flags

nodes.label: Deduplication
nodes.summary: Identify provider replays, then evaluate collision evidence before merging
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Source IDs and cleaned entity attributes
Outputs: Stable canonical key or review candidate

nodes.label: Canonical transformation
nodes.summary: Map country and role, parse timestamps or preserve nulls, then hash description
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Cleaned fields, provenance and job identity
Outputs: CanonicalJob v1

nodes.label: Database persistence
nodes.summary: Atomically upsert the job and source links, allowing safe replay
nodes.notes:
Inputs: CanonicalJob and raw refs
Outputs: Committed UUID and replay reconciliation evidence

nodes.label: Migration
nodes.summary: Apply additive versioned SQL and test upgrade and rollback in disposable PostgreSQL
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Pinned migration history and schema version
Outputs: Ready v1 relational schema

nodes.label: Canonical upsert
nodes.summary: Commit stable UUIDs and uniqueness rules with source links in a transaction
nodes.notes:
Inputs: CanonicalJob v1 and raw refs
Outputs: Stable job ID and source association

nodes.label: Provenance join
nodes.summary: Trace a displayed job or metric cluster back to permitted source records
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Job ID and collection metadata
Outputs: Source, run ID, raw checksum and evidence flags

nodes.label: Versioned enrichment
nodes.summary: Select active enrichment by published configuration while preserving prior evidence
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Enrichment v1 and descriptor hash
Outputs: Reporting view with active job-skill relationships

nodes.label: Canonical job description
nodes.summary: Read the original description by canonical job identifier and content hash
nodes.notes:
Inputs: CanonicalJob v1
Outputs: Eligible description and traceable job identity

nodes.label: Skill extraction
nodes.summary: Recognize Unicode-aware aliases and retain original evidence spans
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Versioned description text and dictionaries
Outputs: Candidate mentions and code-point offsets

nodes.label: Skill normalization
nodes.summary: Normalize candidate text without invalidating original evidence
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Candidate aliases, language and offsets
Outputs: Normalized alias candidates with ambiguity flags

nodes.label: Taxonomy mapping
nodes.summary: Resolve alias to stable taxonomy ID and quarantine ambiguous candidates
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Normalized alias and pinned version
Outputs: Versioned skill IDs or review candidates

nodes.label: Job-skill association
nodes.summary: Group repeated mentions into one skill association while retaining evidence
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Job UUID, skill IDs and evidenced mentions
Outputs: Versioned Enrichment payload

nodes.label: Database write-back
nodes.summary: Publish atomically using the versioned idempotency key
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Enrichment payload and original description hash
Outputs: New immutable enrichment run and active job links

nodes.label: Held-out evaluation
nodes.summary: Compare pinned predictions with independent labels including failed runs
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Blind gold, splits and model/taxonomy metadata
Outputs: Precision, recall, F1, failures and normalization accuracy

nodes.label: Curated data
nodes.summary: Read canonical jobs and the approved active version of enrichment
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Jobs, job_skills and provenance views
Outputs: Eligible rows with date basis and version

nodes.label: Filtering
nodes.summary: Apply the same country, role and half-open date window to the complete cohort
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Curated records and normalized filter values
Outputs: Eligible cohort including unenriched jobs

nodes.label: Aggregation
nodes.summary: Count distinct canonical job IDs per skill and as denominators
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Eligible filtered job rows and enrichment joins
Outputs: Skill counts, enrichment and date coverage

nodes.label: Trend calculation
nodes.summary: Compare equal periods only when date and source coverage gates pass
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Comparable time windows and source mix
Outputs: Trend points or insufficient-data state

nodes.label: Analytics service
nodes.summary: Calculate pure metric responses behind one stable function
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Cohort, aggregate values and coverage policy
Outputs: Typed reporting object and visible provenance notes

nodes.label: API response
nodes.summary: Serialize stable counts and visible metadata under the v1 schema
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Service object and canonical filters
Outputs: SkillDemand v1 or Error v1

nodes.label: Frontend request
nodes.summary: Interpret normalized query keys from the shared filters
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Role, country, date basis, range and cursor
Outputs: Validated request or safe error

nodes.label: API validation
nodes.summary: Apply allowed values, limit bounds and date order through the route schema
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Incoming HTTP parameters
Outputs: Typed filters or 422 Error v1

nodes.label: Service layer
nodes.summary: Route metric and job queries through typed application functions
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Validated request and data services
Outputs: Result paired with request context

nodes.label: Database and analytics
nodes.summary: Call parameterized SQL or metrics service with one validated cohort
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Typed request, stable cursor and repository
Outputs: Rows, coverage and cursor metadata

nodes.label: Response
nodes.summary: Return JSON plus request ID, or a safe dependency error
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Query result or categorized failure
Outputs: 200 response, 422 bad input or 503 dependency error

nodes.label: Filter controls
nodes.summary: Keep country, role, date basis and range synchronized with URL state
nodes.notes:
Inputs: User selections and supported values
Outputs: Canonical dashboard query

nodes.label: API client
nodes.summary: Send bounded requests, abort stale requests and validate response shape
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Filter state and OpenAPI/fixture contract
Outputs: Current metrics response or visible failure

nodes.label: Visualization
nodes.summary: Render ranked normalized skills with sample sizes and date basis
nodes.notes:
Inputs: SkillDemand v1 payload
Outputs: Connected chart or ranked table and provenance hint

nodes.label: Empty and error states
nodes.summary: Distinguish no matches, unavailable service and loading; support keyboard interaction
nodes.notes:
Inputs: API client state
Outputs: Accessible feedback and bounded retry action

nodes.label: CI and checks
nodes.summary: Run static, unit and disposable database tests on synthetic fixtures
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Versioned change and pinned environment
Outputs: Reviewable test report and release gate status

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.summary: Start ingestion or processing under caps with overlap protection
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Approved run configuration and schedule
Outputs: Run ID, checkpoint and terminal status

nodes.label: Logs and health
nodes.summary: Publish health and safe structured counters without payload or secrets
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Service checks and job ledgers
Outputs: Probe result, duration, run ID and safe error class

nodes.label: Backup and release
nodes.summary: Exercise migrations and restore before freezing candidate
nodes.notes:
Inputs: Pinned Compose profile, permitted data and release manifest
Outputs: Verified clean boot and rollback instructions
